lens_definitions.territorial_recognition: Ukraine has sovereignty over all its internationally recognized territory; annexation has no legal recognition.
lens_definitions.troop_withdrawal: Russian forces should withdraw from all internationally recognized Ukrainian territory.
lens_definitions.military_assistance: Supports external military assistance to Ukraine, with type, recipient and conditions preserved.
lens_definitions.sanctions: Supports specified restrictive measures against Russia because of its actions in Ukraine.
lens_definitions.invasion_responsibility: Attributes responsibility for the February 2022 full-scale invasion to the Russian state.
